results.title: Match Review Panel verdict on Lewis, Pangai Junior and Sue incidents
results.description: Hull KR’S Mikey Lewis and Tevita Pangai Junior have both been handed bans for incidents during the defeat to Warrington Wolves on Tuesday.

results.title: Fearless Donovan relishing Celtic's Champions League charge
results.description: Colby Donovan says he plays with "no fear" after the 19-year-old's impressive individual display helped Celtic take command of their Champions League play-off against LASK. The right-back showed up well in the absence of the injured Alistair Johnston as the Scottish champions carved out a 3-0 lead to take to Austria for Tuesday's second leg. "I feel comfortable in every game I go into," Donovan said.
